title: 生態系統整合
content:
Photon's zero-shim architecture makes it easy to integrate with the broader JavaScript ecosystem. We provide official modules for common tasks and patterns for third-party tools.

GraphQL Integration

For GraphQL, we recommend using GraphQL Yoga directly. It is lightweight and works seamlessly with Photon's native Request/Response handling.

import { createYoga } from 'graphql-yoga'

const yoga = createYoga({ schema })

app.all('/graphql', (c) => yoga.fetch(c.req.raw))

Job Queues

@gravito/stream is our high-performance queue system. It works as a standalone service that you can call from your Photon handlers.

import { OrbitStream, Job } from '@gravito/stream'

// Initialize the stream handler
const stream = new OrbitStream({ /* config */ })

class EmailJob extends Job {
  async handle() { /* ... */ }
}

// Push to queue from a route
app.post('/api/notify', async (c) => {
  await stream.push(new EmailJob(c.req.json()))
  return c.json({ queued: true })
})

OpenAPI / Swagger

For API documentation, we recommend using @asteasolutions/zod-to-openapi. Since Photon uses standard Zod schemas, you can register them to generate specifications automatically.

import { OpenAPIRegistry } from '@asteasolutions/zod-to-openapi'

const registry = new OpenAPIRegistry()
registry.registerPath({
  method: 'get',
  path: '/users',
  responses: { 200: { description: 'User list' } }
})

Monitoring (Sentry)

You can integrate Sentry using a global middleware that wraps the execution context.

import * as Sentry from '@sentry/bun'

app.use(async (c, next) => {
  try {
    await next()
  } catch (err) {
    Sentry.captureException(err)
    throw err
  }
})
